instruction: Locate the HuggingFace daily papers for March 1st, 2024, and record at least one more paper in the document, ensuring each entry includes Title, Authors, Abstract, and Arxiv PDF link.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(1); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding papers from HuggingFace to docx. Original has 2 'Arxiv PDF:' entries. Evaluator counts arxiv links. Expected: at least 3 links. Verified source has 2 arxiv entries.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: Instruction requires each paper entry to include Title, Authors, Abstract, and Arxiv PDF link (4 components), but evaluator only verifies Arxiv PDF links
Evaluator counts paragraphs starting with 'Arxiv PDF:' but does not verify that Title, Authors, or Abstract are present for each paper
An agent could add only 'Arxiv PDF: https://arxiv.org/...' without Title/Authors/Abstract and still pass the evaluation
The evaluator verifies only 1 of 4 required components per paper entry, missing 75% of the instruction requirements
Postconfig is appropriate (saves document with Ctrl+S before verification)
The counting logic and threshold comparison (>=3) are correct for what they do, but insufficient for full instruction verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Enhance getter to verify all 4 components per paper: count complete entries that have Title, Authors, Abstract, AND Arxiv PDF link (not just arxiv links)
Implement pattern matching to identify complete paper entries in the document structure
For each paper entry, verify presence of all required fields: look for 'Title:', 'Authors:', 'Abstract:', 'Arxiv PDF:' markers or similar patterns
Alternative: Simplify instruction to only require 'Add at least one more Arxiv PDF link' if full verification is too complex, OR keep instruction as-is but fix evaluator to check all components
